d: Stations and colony systems in C. J. Cherryh’s Alliance–Union universe.

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Major space station orbiting Pell’s World at Tau Ceti; fulcrum of the Company Wars between Earth Fleet and Union merchanters.

gaia-2739689239311660672.x: Harsh, chemically alien capital world of the Union orbiting Gliese 908; home of Reseune and master of azi clone technology.

gaia-2261614264931057664.x: Major commercial space station in the Sigma Draconis system connecting the Great Circle trade routes.

b.s: Hugo Award-winning hard space opera detailing the Company Wars between corporate Earth and the rebellious Union colonies.
